description: End-to-end meeting workflow skill. Pre-meeting: research attendees, build agenda, prepare talking points, create pre-read. Post-meeting: process notes into action items, draft follow-up emails, log decisions, update project notes. Useful for preparing for important calls, during post-meeting processing, when following up with attendees, and for building a running decision log. Use when the user says "prepare for meeting", "meeting prep", "process meeting notes", "meeting follow up", "meeting machine", or "prep for my call".
